Riverbend Shelter

Riverbend offers overnight shelter and a weekly food pantry.

Shelter

Shelter check-in: Daily 6pm-8pm. Beds are assigned by lottery at 7:30 p.m.

Food pantry

Pantry hours: Tuesdays 1pm-3pm.

Call the shelter line at 303-555-0190 or the pantry at 303-555-0191.

Please bring a photo ID if you have one; we will still serve you without it.
